cases.name: brush-suite:extended_tests:29
cases.script:
pattern='(Hello), ([a-z]+)\.'
if [[ "Hello, world." =~ ${pattern} ]]; then
    echo "Match found!"
    for i in "${!BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; do
        echo "$i: '${BASH_REMATCH[$i]}'"
    done
fi

cases.name: brush-suite:extended_tests:30
cases.script:
pattern='(Hello)(,?) ([a-z]+)\.'
if [[ "Hello world." =~ ${pattern} ]]; then
    echo "Match found!"
    for i in "${!BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; do
        echo "$i: '${BASH_REMATCH[$i]}'"
    done
fi

cases.name: brush-suite:extended_tests:35
cases.script:
[[ "x" =~ (a| *) ]]   && echo "1. Matched"
[[ "a b" =~ ^(a |b) ]] && echo "2. Matched: [${BASH_REMATCH[0]}]"
[[ "a b" =~ ^(a |b)$ ]] || echo "3. No match"
[[ " " =~ ^( )$ ]]    && echo "4. Matched: [${BASH_REMATCH[1]}]"

cases.name: brush-suite:extended_tests:70
cases.script:
s=$'a\nb'
[[ $s =~ ^b ]] && echo "wrong 1" || echo "ok 1"
[[ $s =~ a$ ]] && echo "wrong 2" || echo "ok 2"
[[ $s =~ ^a.b$ ]] && echo "ok 3"
t=$' \t\nabc \t\n'
re=$'[ \t\n]+$'
[[ $t =~ $re ]] && printf '[%s]\n' "${t::${#t}-${#BASH_REMATCH}}"

cases.name: bashkit-suite:bashbox-interpreter-core:871
cases.script: re='('; [[ a =~ $re ]]; echo $?; re='[[:foo:]]'; [[ a =~ $re ]]; echo $?; [[ abc =~ b(c) ]]; echo $? ${BASH_REMATCH[@]}

cases.name: bashkit-suite:control-flow:444
cases.script:
x="error: line 42"
if [[ "$x" =~ error:\ line\ ([0-9]+) ]]; then
  echo "line ${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
else
  echo "no match"
fi

cases.name: local captures restore global
cases.script: BASH_REMATCH=(global); f(){ local BASH_REMATCH=(local spare); [[ abc123 =~ ([0-9]+) ]]; printf '<%s>\n' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"; }; f; printf '<%s>\n' "${BASH_REMATCH[@]}"
